title: Character Expansion Pack - Paladin, Gunslinger & Alchemist
description:
[h1]Character Expansion Pack[/h1]
Three new characters for Slay the Spire 2, built to be played together. One mod, so a co-op lobby only has to match a single gameplay-affecting dependency.

[h2]The Paladin[/h2]
[i]Sworn to a light that has not answered in a long time. Holds the line anyway.[/i]
A tank who buffs early and cashes in late. Every combat opens with [b]Plating[/b]: Block that arrives at the end of your turn, before the enemy swings, and decays one point a turn. Three lanes to build into: [b]Protection[/b] (Plating that grows, and retaliation when you are hit), [b]Retribution[/b] (carry one [b]Seal[/b] at a time, then [b]Judge[/b] to fire its payoff and spend it) and [b]Holy[/b] (heals that scale with [b]Spirit[/b] and Exhaust, so every real cast is a candle spent). 86 cards, 8 relics, 3 potions.

[h2]The Gunslinger[/h2]
[i]A weathered shooter off an endless road. Loads the cylinder, counts what is coming, and decides whether this is a turn for cover or for everything at once.[/i]
A sequencing character with a visible six-chamber [b]Cylinder[/b] on screen. [b]Load[/b] rounds of different kinds, then choose each turn: [b]Fire[/b] what is under the hammer, [b]Cycle[/b] to reorder, or [b]Spin[/b] and take your chances. Stack [b]Deadeye[/b] and cash it out in one shot. A parallel [b]Gadgets[/b] archetype skips the gun entirely. 104 cards, 9 relics, 3 potions.

[h2]The Alchemist[/h2]
[i]Treats the Spire as a very large, very hostile experiment. Takes notes between fights.[/i]
Nothing is useless; some things simply have not been converted yet. Three pools hold value, [b]Potions[/b], [b]Gold[/b] and [b]Max HP[/b], and one verb, [b]Transform[/b], moves it between them and your hand: [b]Brew[/b] Volatile Potions into a [b]Belt[/b], [b]Distill[/b] them back into cards, [b]Invest[/b] Gold in combat, [b]Render[/b] Max HP you will never get back. The Alchemist never has the most of anything. It keeps the least sitting still. 90 cards, 9 relics, 25 potions.

[h2]Playtest build[/h2]
v0.0.1, built against game v0.107.1. [b]Requires BaseLib 3.4.5 exactly[/b]; 3.4.6 and later are not yet supported. Character bodies are recoloured base-game rigs for now, some card and relic art is placeholder, and balance is in progress. Everyone in a co-op lobby must be on the same version.
